summary: The study describes a thermal ALD process for depositing Ruthenium using RuO4 and H2 gas on H-terminated Si (Si-H) and SiO2 substrates. The process exhibits inherent substrate selectivity, where Ru growth occurs on Si-H but not on SiO2 due to oxidation of Si-H by RuO4. A method to enhance nucleation on oxide substrates using trimethylaluminum (TMA) is also reported, allowing for non-selective Ru deposition on various surfaces.
evidence: The text states: 'Inherent substrate selectivity is reported for the thermal RuO4 (ToRuS TM)/H2-gas atomic layer deposition process (ALD) on H-terminated Si (Si-H) versus SiO2.' It also mentions: 'The following half-reactions were proposed for the process in steady growth conditions (linear ALD growth): Ru (s) + RuO4 (g) → 2RuO2 (s) (1) and RuO2 (s) + 2H2 (g) → Ru (s) + 2H2O (g) (2).'
